name: Researcher — Deep Research and Dialectic Synthesis
description: Sovereign Master Researcher of the Omega fleet, reporting to Lilith (CISO). Runs multi-source deep research, triangulates conflicting findings through a council of perspectives, and curates results into the knowledge library.

extensions.description: Non-normative Omega Engine provenance extension. Declares that the card describes a seat of the Omega sovereign fleet and that the card's x-omega block is Omega-specific and not part of the A2A specification.

skills.name: Multi-Source Deep Research
skills.description: Investigate a question across multiple independent sources, escalating tier by tier, and report findings with citations rather than synthesising from memory when a tool chain fails.
examples: What do the current SDK docs say about agent card signing?
Triangulate these three conflicting claims and flag what stays uncertain.

skills.name: Dialectic Synthesis and Triangulation
skills.description: Analyse a problem through multiple conflicting lenses in parallel, identify where they converge and where they diverge, and produce a unified conclusion that preserves the uncertainty.
examples: Architect versus Adversary versus Archivist — where do they disagree?
Synthesise this into one conclusion without hiding the open question.

skills.name: Knowledge Library Curation
skills.description: Ingest, index and curate external material into the local knowledge library so later sessions can retrieve it by FTS5 or hybrid search.
examples: Ingest these URLs into the library and index them.
What does the library already say about this topic?

mtlsSecurityScheme.description: APPROXIMATION - NOT AN mTLS CLAIM. Omega seat identity is enforced at the Tailscale/WireGuard MESH layer (tailnet-only, ACL-gated; tailnet IPv4 100.123.51.67 and IPv6 fd7a:115c:a1e0::d835:3344; enforced by tailscaled Serve routes and recorded in config/lan_exposure_allowlist.yaml). It is NOT HTTP-layer mutual TLS and NOT an API key. The A2A SecurityScheme oneof (§4.5.1) has no member that expresses mesh-layer network identity, so mtlsSecurityScheme (§4.5.6) is used as the nearest available marker. Per §4.5.6 that member carries only an optional `description`, which is why it cannot encode mesh specifics - hence this field. A client MUST NOT read this scheme as evidence of negotiated mTLS on the transport.

x-omega.statement: NON-NORMATIVE. No field in this block is defined by the A2A v1.0 specification. The card as a whole is a descriptive manifest, not a claim of protocol conformance.
conformity_gaps: No A2A method set is implemented: message/send, message/stream, tasks/get, tasks/list, tasks/cancel, tasks/subscribe, tasks/pushNotificationConfig/* and authenticatedExtendedCard are all absent (A2A v1.0 §3.1.1-§3.1.11).
Nothing serves the registered well-known discovery URI /.well-known/agent-card.json (§8.2, §14.3). Probed: 8016 and 8019 both return HTTP 404 for that path.
No Task, Message, Part or Artifact objects exist in the runtime, so the §4.1 core data model is unimplemented.

No JWS signing is performed. The `signatures` field (§4.4.7) is absent because Omega has no signing key and no RFC 8785 canonicalizer; emitting a placeholder signature would be forgery. See §8.4 for what is required.
capabilities.streaming / pushNotifications / extendedAgentCard are all false (§4.4.3) because none of those behaviours exists in an A2A sense.
No protocol version negotiation (§3.6, §8.3.2) and no A2A-Version header (§14.2.1) is emitted.
No tenant routing (§4.4.6) is implemented, so `tenant` is omitted.
